controls.label: Map traverse
controls.description: Show the Traverse prompt on the world map. Hover a point, then press T on the keyboard or click the left stick (L3) on a controller. Turning this off leaves the game's own map untouched.

controls.label: Confirmation
controls.description: Whether pressing Traverse opens the game's confirmation dialog first. Ask before traversing is the safe default; Traverse right away goes on the first press.

controls.label: Allow locked points
controls.description: Traverse to points you have not unlocked or activated yet, including gates and dungeons the game would normally gate behind fast travel. Turn this off to show the prompt only on points the game already lets you fast travel to.

controls.label: Meteor arrival
controls.description: Arrive as a falling meteor: the character drops from the sky as the game's own comet under the launcher camera, then lands with the 4-point pose, impact effects, rumble and sound. Turn this off to arrive with a plain streaming teleport. Works the same on a stock shell or a CSS custom shell.
